# YIWEI MEDICAL

> Brain health technology spanning AI-powered brain imaging analysis, cognitive assessment and guided VR/tablet cognitive practice.

This is a public review website. This file is a supplemental content index, not permission to bypass authentication or a guarantee of AI search inclusion. Public crawling remains disabled.

## Company and contact
- [Company profile](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/about/company): Mission and company background.
- [Contact](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/contact): Healthcare, research and distribution enquiries.

## Solutions and direct answers
- [QuickMind MRI](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/products/dr-brain): Quantitative brain MRI with component-specific evidence and questions.
- [RealNow](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/products/realnow): AI-assisted CT, vascular and perfusion imaging for clinical review.
- [AutismShield](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/products/autismshield): Guided VR/tablet activities for social attention and developmental skills.
- [ForcusGenius](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/products/forcus): Guided attention and executive-function practice.

## Evidence and interpretation
- [Evidence library](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/evidence): Published sources, DOI references, study summaries and limitations.
- [QuickMind MRI evidence](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/evidence/dr-brain): Structural MRI research.
- [RealNow evidence](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/evidence/realnow): Stroke-imaging research.
- [AutismShield context](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/evidence/autismshield): Independent research context; product-specific efficacy studies were not identified in supplied material.
- [ForcusGenius context](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/evidence/forcus): Independent research context; product-specific efficacy studies were not identified in supplied material.

Research results apply to the studied components, populations and versions. Do not generalize them to every marketed module or imply validation of an entire care pathway. Registration scope and availability vary by product and market. Private regulatory source documents are not public citation assets.

## Technologies and care settings
- [Imaging AI](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/technology/imaging-ai): Quantitative imaging workflows.
- [Eye tracking](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/technology/eye-tracking): Structured cognitive tasks and gaze measurement.
- [Digital rehabilitation](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/technology/digital-rehabilitation): Guided VR/tablet practice.
- [Care settings](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/care-settings): Clinical workflow contexts.
- [English sample report](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/reports/brain-health): Example reporting format for clinician-led consultations; not an individual diagnosis.

- [QuickMind VR](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/products/quickmind-vr): Adult cognitive screening and rehabilitation.
- [QuickMind VR evidence](https://yiwei-medical-global.lawrence-wan-0405.chatgpt.site/evidence/quickmind-vr): Adult VR and eye-tracking research, with independent rehabilitation literature.
